importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 7725 amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 to require states to include descriptions of internal controls, fraud investigation, sanctions, eligibility verification, and multi-agency data utilization in their plans. It affects state agencies and child care providers receiving assistance, but the source does not specify funding amounts or the number of people affected.
